intent: new species illustration; supplied images are style-only references

tool_arguments.prompt:
Create ONE NEW Num-Num Numbers ANTHROPOMORPHIC ANIMAL CHARACTER, in exactly the character family of the three supplied references: Siamese cat, hedgehog and tiger. These are direct STYLE AND MASCOT BODY-PROPORTION REFERENCES, not edit targets. The new animal MUST be slightly humanized: upright on TWO short feet, compact short torso, TWO forelimbs serving as relaxed ARMS/HANDS beside the belly, a large rounded head about half the height excluding horns/ears, expressive large simple oval eyes with cream-white sclera and warm brown pupils, and a gentle human-like friendly smile. Match their soft warm-brown drawn contour, textured watercolor/paper grain, round shapes and simple flat picture-book rendering. The result must read as a friendly standing cast member who could wave or talk, rather than a picture of a wild animal. No four-legged walking stance, no naturalistic long narrow body, no realistic small animal eyes. Species identifiers remain, but body proportions follow the mascot references. No clothing, hats, props or added objects. One full body centered front or very slight 3/4 view in a square canvas with all extremities inside generous transparent margins. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no scenery, no ground/shadow disc, no text or watermark.
Subject: クロアシイタチ / Black Footed Ferret (Mustela nigripes). Species colors/identifiers (reinterpret the body into the required pattern): slender cream buff ferret with distinct black eye mask, dark feet and black tail tip; four short legs and long neck
The species brief does NOT override the required upright two-arm/two-leg mascot proportions. Keep the large expressive head, short standing torso and human-like arm gesture of the three reference cast members.
Specific constraints: A slightly anthropomorphic cream/buff FERRET cast member, dark black eye mask surrounding large cream-white/brown oval eyes, dark rounded hand-paws and feet, black tip on one slim tail. Large rounded ferret head with small ears and friendly smile, short upright plump torso, TWO short forearms beside belly and TWO short standing feet. No long natural four-legged ferret body.
